verdicts.reason: B splits the pricing pipeline into small named steps (validate, discountedAmount, applyCoupon, shippingCost) that document the discount order and can each be read, tested and changed in isolation, whereas A interleaves subtotal, member discount, quantity and weight in one loop and keeps all rules in a single long function.

Version A names each pricing rule (validate, memberDiscount, applyCoupon, shippingCost) so each can be read, tested and changed in isolation, whereas Version B folds everything into one ~90-line Quote where a change to one rule risks touching the shared loop and intermediate variables.
